announcements.title: CLINIC HOURS - Week of December 21st
announcements.message: The office will be closed on December 21st and 22nd. Televisits will still be available on those dates. Regular in-office clinic hours will resume on December 24th.
announcements.notificationMessage: The clinic will be closed for in-person visits on Monday, December 21st, and Tuesday, December 22nd. Online televisits will remain available. Regular clinic operations will resume on Thursday, December 24th.
